chunks: Till he reached a place between two mountains, and found this side of it a people who understood but little of what was spoken.
ai.seo_question: Who did Dhul-Qarnayn meet between the two barriers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks Dhul-Qarnayn's arrival at the western or eastern extremity of his journey, where he encountered the Gog and Magog (Yajuj and Majuj) tribes. Their difficulty in understanding speech highlights their distinct linguistic or cultural isolation, serving as a precursor to their eventual emergence as a major eschatological sign in Islamic tradition.
